description.value: Islands Café is a Hawaii-inspired coffee roaster and café with an unusual origin: it began as a surfboard company before pivoting to café and then to in-house coffee roasting. The White Rock location, branded 'Makai,' is the company's head office and one of three cafés operating across the region. Cyclists on Johnston Road will find a laid-back surf-culture atmosphere and freshly roasted beans, with an online shop also available for coffee subscriptions.
